properties.source: OpenStreetMap via Overpass (ODbL) — landuse=industrial / building~industrial|warehouse|factory within 3.0 km of a PT ≥20 MVA E-REDES node (generation hosting capacity proxy)
properties.note: Candidate sites ONLY — target-then-verify. A building's connected power is not publicly screenable (CUPS/DSO enquiry or equivalent only). area_ha uses a simple planar approximation, indicative only. anchors are E-REDES generation hosting-capacity nodes — a grid-strength proxy, NOT demand headroom.
